fields.statement: At 0b0801d5b, I read the README diff from the merge-base. It names install.sh (curl ... install.sh | sh, --dir, --channel latest), both manifest URLs, releases/latest/download/manifest.json for release and releases/download/latest/manifest.json for latest, which match install.sh lines 47-48. It keeps go install and covers verification with sha256sum/shasum -a 256 and `gh attestation verify rhiza_<version>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz --repo dphaener/rhiza`. Then I made a clean detached worktree at that commit and ran `rhiza check` there, with a binary built from the commit and RHIZA_ROOT/CHANGE/RUN unset. It printed ok and exited 0, with only pre-existing 'unclaimed' warnings, and no render failures. That fixes attempt 1's finding about the stale rendered actor claude-code-a6fbcd94.
